run_text_generation: run conditional text generation with GPT-2, CTRL, XLNet, or other auto-regressive models via CLI
run_model_generation_from_file: run text generation from a file of prompts using a specified pre-trained transformer model
run_generation_with_temperature: run text generation with adjustable temperature, top-k, top-p, and repetition penalty parameters
run_generation_with_stop_token: run text generation that stops at a specified token and saves output to a file
run_generation_with_seed: run reproducible text generation by setting a fixed random seed for numpy and torch
